description: Find EU or national legislation by title words, abbreviation or number in one call. Returns compact items with stable id, official links (EUR-Lex/ELI/CELEX or the national official portal), title, date, source, source_url and retrieved_at. Every item has status (in_force | repealed | unknown; in_force only when the official source says so), consolidated_url (current consolidated text, or null when the source has none), checked_at (date the status was read) and status_source. Search: EU (CELLAR, 24 languages via lang) and DE, EE, ES, AT, NL, PL, DK, LU, SE, IE, IT, LT, FI, CZ, HR, LV, SI, FR. France (Légifrance): codes and consolidated laws by title or number (e.g. '78-17'), article text by '<code> article <n>' (e.g. 'Code civil article 1240'), and French case law (JUDILIBRE, Cour de cassation) with a 'juri:' prefix (e.g. 'juri:clause de non-concurrence'). Other EU Member States: returns the official portal, its search link and ELI pattern (link_only). Free, read-only, no API key during beta. No legal advice.

country.description: EU (default) or an EU Member State ISO code. Search: EU, DE, EE, ES, AT, NL, PL, DK, LU, SE, IE, IT, LT, FI, CZ, HR, LV, SI, FR; all 27 Member States return at least official portal links.

in_force_only.description: Default true (EU, ES). EE results are always the acts in force today.

lang.description: EU only: two-letter language of the title and EUR-Lex link, default en.

query.description: Title words, abbreviation or number, e.g. 'general data protection', '2016/679', 'GmbHG', 'Äriseadustik', 'sociedades de capital'.

name: find_law
